regressions.rule: A slot sha3(k, m) + c of a known mapping m is m[k].field_(256c): print it so; when a variable already holds k on every path, use it rather than the hashed memory it came from.

improvements: P2 15 -> 3, P6 10 -> 0, P4 9 -> 8 (native fee key now sha3(chainid, Bytes(20, 0))). Implicit copy loops 54 -> 29 whiles (sendMessage 6 -> 0, claim 18 -> 6, send 15 -> 10, sendMessage#2 6 -> 4): Sent's submissionId is now sha3 of the packed fields. _addAsset's bytes write of abi.encodePacked(token) is now the exact 20-byte short form (length byte 40, data in field_96) instead of the generic long/short branches. The SafeERC20 tails in claim are early reverts with decoded strings, without the error-string copy loops. Custom errors are decoded (TransferAmountTooHigh, TransferAmountNotCoverFees, NotSupportedFixedFee, WrongAutoArgument), PairAdded/MonitoringClaimEvent/MonitoringSendEvent have named fields, transfer/transferFrom/burn calls are named, feeDiscount fields replace memory slices, and deployAsset's two strings are now two separate Array arguments. 3141 -> 2726 lines.
notes: Diff 1927 lines; 7 changed functions (def storage, supportsInterface and deployNewAsset trivial or display-only), reviewed by skeleton comparison plus full reading of the changed regions. sendMessage(3 args) shrank 349 -> 193: with flags = 6 folded, the SEND_HASHED_DATA arm is dropped and the keccak256(data) arm kept, as the source requires; the 20-byte nativeAddress branch is the only live one. send: both arms that define _173 are now decoded (sha3(stor263[token].field_0, nativeAddress) / sha3(chainid, Bytes(20, token))). The later discount products print as SafeMath.mul where the old text used a plain '*' after the same check: neutral. def storage now says 'stor1 is fixed array of struct of 1 slot' (was 'array of array'), both odd for uint256[50] __gap. _addAsset's AssetAlreadyExist/ZeroAddress reverts stay raw ('from _119 + 52 len _118 - _119 + 4'), as before.
summary: Much clearer: 25 copy loops folded, calls/events/errors decoded, the nativeAddress storage write exact and short, 415 lines fewer. One low naming regression: in send, 8 getDebridge accesses now print as stor1/2/4[_174] instead of debridge[_173].field_N.
